technique_name: Compare and contrast democratic and autocratic forms of government
description: Democratic forms of government are based on the principle of majority rule, where the people have a say in how the government is run. Autocratic forms of government are based on the idea of rule by one person or a small group of people who have absolute power and control over the populace. In democratic systems, the citizens have the right to participate in the decision-making process and are able to hold elected officials accountable.
